item.title: IntelliJ
item.description:
Learn IntelliJ

There is now a guided way to learn this complex tool - this video introduces it:

  • Learn IntelliJ IDEA (2021) - YouTube

Code Formatting

As soon as you share code using Source Code Management (e.g. Git), you should take care that everyone in the team uses the same code formatting - otherwise changes in formatting will make it hard to track and understand the real changes.

  • Reformat and rearrange code | IntelliJ IDEA
  • Code Formatting | The IntelliJ IDEA Blog
